Normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) fits the triad of gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, and cognitive decline—but the patient’s reported symptoms emphasize disinhibition and gaze difficulty without mention of gait instability or incontinence, and NPH does not cause true supranuclear gaze palsy; thus it is less likely, though still worth imaging to exclude."}
